experiences.name: Phi Phi Islands Snorkeling & Island Hopping Tour
experiences.description: Embark on a full-day longtail boat tour around the stunning Phi Phi archipelago, snorkeling at Maya Bay, exploring Monkey Beach, and swimming in crystal-clear turquoise lagoons. Start early morning to beat the crowds and midday heat. If weather turns, retreat to beachside cafes or the small local market on Phi Phi Don for shade and snacks.

experiences.name: Bangkok Street Food Night Market Tour
experiences.description: Explore the legendary street food scene at Yaowarat (Chinatown) and the nearby Talat Noi neighborhood after sunset when temperatures drop. Sample pad thai, mango sticky rice, grilled satay, boat noodles, and fresh seafood from hawker stalls. An indoor alternative is the air-conditioned Or Tor Kor Market, one of Bangkok's finest fresh markets, open during the day.

experiences.name: Koh Lanta Sunrise Kayaking & Mangrove Exploration
experiences.description: Paddle through serene mangrove forests and hidden sea caves along Koh Lanta's eastern coast at sunrise before the heat sets in. A local guide leads you through narrow channels teeming with wildlife, ending at a quiet beach for breakfast. On rainy days, visit the charming Old Town (Ban Ko Lanta) with its stilted wooden shophouses, local museums, and coffee shops.

experiences.name: Chiang Mai Thai Cooking Class & Local Market Visit
experiences.description: Join a hands-on morning cooking class at a traditional Thai home kitchen in the Nimman area. Begin with a guided tour of Warorot Market to select fresh herbs, chilies, and produce, then cook five classic dishes including green curry and som tum. The indoor kitchen setting makes this a perfect activity during midday heat or afternoon rain showers.

experiences.name: Koh Samui Sunset Beachfront Dinner & Fire Show
experiences.description: Spend a magical evening on Chaweng Beach watching a traditional Thai fire show performance while dining on freshly grilled seafood and local specialties at a beachfront restaurant. The cool evening breeze makes this a comfortable and atmospheric experience. If it rains, many beachfront venues have covered terraces and continue performances under shelter.
